items.title: MCP server for AI compliance documentation (Colorado AI Act)
items.raw_excerpt:
I built an MCP server that gives AI agents access to compliance documentation — starting with the Colorado AI Act (SB 24-205), effective June 30, 2026. The problem: organizations deploying AI in hiring, lending, insurance, or healthcare decisions need specific documentation — risk management policies, impact assessments, consumer notifications, bias testing docs, and appeal mechanisms. Most teams either pay $50K+ for a GRC platform, hire a law firm at $500/hr, or wing it. What I built: compliance protocols that are both human-readable (PDF) and agent-readable (structured JSON via MCP/CLI/API). Your AI assistant can check if you're a deployer, pull protocol schemas, and help you implement them. Tools available via MCP:
- colorado_ai_act_check — are you a deployer?
- list_protocols — browse

items.title: AgentGuard – a QA engine that sits between AI coding agents and LLMs
items.raw_excerpt:
AI coding agents are great at generating code, but terrible at respecting architecture.
We kept getting code that looked correct but didn’t type-check, had hallucinated imports,
or ignored project boundaries. AgentGuard is an open-source quality-assurance engine that sits between an AI coding agent
and the LLM. It enforces a top-down generation pipeline: Skeleton → Contracts → Wiring → Logic Each stage constrains the next, and we validate syntax, imports, linting and types before
any human sees the code. The LLM also self-reviews its output against explicit criteria. AgentGuard supports MCP (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline) and tracks token cost
per model and run. Python 3.11+, MIT licensed.

title_i18n.en: AgentGuard – a QA engine that sits between AI coding agents and LLMs
title_i18n.zh: AgentGuard——一款位于AI编程助手与大型语言模型之间的质量保证引擎。
title_i18n.es: AgentGuard: un motor de control de calidad que actúa como intermediario entre agentes de codificación de IA y modelos de lenguaje extensos.

excerpt_i18n.en:
AI coding agents are great at generating code, but terrible at respecting architecture.
We kept getting code that looked correct but didn’t type-check, had hallucinated imports,
or ignored project boundaries. AgentGuard is an open-source quality-assurance engine that sits between an AI coding agent
and the LLM. It enforces a top-down generation pipeline: Skeleton → Contracts → Wiring → Logic Each stage constrains the next, and we validate syntax, imports, linting and types before
any human sees the code. The LLM also self-reviews its output against explicit criteria. AgentGuard supports MCP (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline) and tracks token cost
per model and run. Python 3.11+, MIT licensed.
excerpt_i18n.zh: AI编程助手擅长生成代码，却难以遵循架构规范。我们不断遇到看似正确却无法通过类型检查的代码，其中包含虚构的导入项，或无视项目边界。AgentGuard
excerpt_i18n.es: Los agentes de IA para programación son excelentes generando código, pero pésimos respetando la arquitectura. Seguíamos recibiendo código que parecía correcto pero no pasaba la verificación de tipos, contenía importaciones alucinadas o ignoraba los límites del proyecto. AgentGuard

items.title: Discussion: What would an AI government look like?
items.raw_excerpt: I haven't really heard anyone bring up this topic, so I thought I'd open a discussion here. To me the appeals are obvious. AI governments could theoretically be incorruptible, tireless, consistent, and capable of processing vastly more information than human bureaucracies. They wouldn't accept bribes, play favorites for personal gain, or make decisions based on re-election anxiety. Policy could be optimized across decades rather than election cycles. Practically, I don't know how it would work. What do people here think?

title_i18n.en: Discussion: What would an AI government look like?
title_i18n.zh: 讨论：人工智能治理将呈现何种面貌？
title_i18n.es: Discusión: ¿Cómo sería un gobierno dirigido por inteligencia artificial?

excerpt_i18n.en: I haven't really heard anyone bring up this topic, so I thought I'd open a discussion here. To me the appeals are obvious. AI governments could theoretically be incorruptible, tireless, consistent, and capable of processing vastly more information than human bureaucracies. They wouldn't accept bribes, play favorites for personal gain, or make decisions based on re-election anxiety. Policy could be optimized across decades rather than election cycles. Practically, I don't know how it would work. What do people here think?
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我确实没怎么听人提起过这个话题，所以想在这里开启讨论。在我看来，其吸引力显而易见。理论上，人工智能政府可以做到廉洁奉公、不知疲倦、始终如一，并且能够高效处理事务。
excerpt_i18n.es: No he escuchado a nadie mencionar este tema realmente, así que pensé en abrir una discusión aquí. Para mí, los atractivos son evidentes. Los gobiernos de IA podrían ser teóricamente incorruptibles, incansables, consistentes y capaces de procesar.

items.title: 赌上 AI 未来，万人团队裁掉近半！前推特 CEO放话：一年后大多数公司都得这么干
items.raw_excerpt: 昨天，向来公开欣赏 Elon Musk（埃隆·马斯克）的 X（原名为 Twitter）前 CEO Jack Dorsey 宣布，由他创立、旗下拥有 Square、Cash App 和 Tidal 的支付公司 Block，将裁员 4000 多人，接近全球员工总数的一半，员工规模从 1 万多人缩减至不足 6000 人。

title_i18n.zh: 赌上 AI 未来，万人团队裁掉近半！前推特 CEO放话：一年后大多数公司都得这么干
title_i18n.en: Betting on the future of AI, a team of ten thousand has been cut by nearly half! The former Twitter CEO declared: in a year, most companies will have to do the same.
title_i18n.es: Apostando por el futuro de la IA, ¡el equipo de diez mil personas reduce casi a la mitad! El ex CEO de Twitter declara: dentro de un año, la mayoría de las empresas tendrán que hacer lo mismo.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 昨天，向来公开欣赏 Elon Musk（埃隆·马斯克）的 X（原名为 Twitter）前 CEO Jack Dorsey 宣布，由他创立、旗下拥有 Square、Cash App 和 Tidal 的支付公司 Block，将裁员 4000 多人，接近全球员工总数的一半，员工规模从 1 万多人缩减至不足 6000 人。
excerpt_i18n.en: Yesterday, Jack Dorsey, the former CEO of X (formerly known as Twitter) who has long publicly admired Elon Musk, announced that Block, the payment company he founded which owns Square, Cash App, and Tidal, will lay off over 4,000 employees, nearly half of its global workforce, reducing staff from over 10,000 to fewer than 6,000.
excerpt_i18n.es: Ayer, Jack Dorsey, ex CEO de X (anteriormente conocido como Twitter) y conocido por su admiración pública hacia Elon Musk, anunció que Block, la empresa de pagos que fundó y que posee Square, Cash App y Tidal, despedirá a más de 4,000 empleados, lo que representa casi la mitad de su plantilla global. Esto reducirá el número de empleados de más de 10,000 a menos de 6,000.
